svg.title: Playback observes; execution replay acts again
svg.desc: The original immutable event log has two different uses. Read-only playback formats saved events and performs no tool calls. Execution replay extracts recorded model responses, feeds them to FakeModel, and executes only approved disposable local tools in a new clean fixture. That execution creates a new run ID and new event log. Compare normalized decisions and output hashes with the original, leaving its log and workspace unchanged.
